profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is recorded as a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and CIK 0001963685. The website associated with the company in the available facts is rolls-royce.com.

The text harvested from that site describes Rolls-Royce, not Richtech Robotics. In that text, Rolls-Royce says it develops and delivers complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land, and describes itself as pioneering technologies that deliver clean, safe and competitive solutions for the planet's power needs. The same text cites a completed $1 Billion investment in Indiana, a stated strategic intent with Reliance Industries to develop India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, cooperation with the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and Rolls-Royce SMR contractual commitments to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

The available facts list no products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company. Its law exposure is recorded under Nevada with a count of zero.
